source_basis: All before identities are read directly from the frozen source. Earlier plans supply historical context only; their IO3/IO4 reassignment and NC6/NC7 assignment are not applied or merged. This plan retains original actual bonded IO1/IO2 and uses NC10/NC9 only as external upstream copper lands.

root_addition_location.description: Insert new wire and global_label nodes immediately before schematic root closing parenthesis.

embedded_variant_addition_location.description: Append the new embedded variant within lib_symbols; preserve every existing embedded symbol.

paired_schematic.recommended_visible_note: U15 physical 1 (IO1) is the RX clamp; physical 2 (IO2) is the TX clamp. NC10 carries RX and NC9 carries TX on the upstream connector side as external board copper lands only. Board copper joins 10-1 and separately 9-2. NC lands have no internal conduction or clamp function. IO3/IO4 and NC6/NC7 remain unused.

Subtract only actual clamp pad copper from every copper object on the actual clamp pad layer(s), split resulting polygon pieces, rebuild physical contact graph including existing plated through connections. No component-internal conductive paths are assumed. Signal nets have no zones. Conservative overestimate of surviving copper and underestimate of pad removal.

Do not move existing bonded pin wires, labels or NC4/5 marks. The source already contains its U13 cycle; do not apply that historical cycle twice.

A versioned native11 constructor must separately set U15.9/U15.10 nets, separately translate the entire U15 footprint, and perform only the selected explicit copper transaction. A fresh published-source reproduction may include both its existing U13 cycle and the two U15 NC net changes, with source-specific assertions.

Versioned verifier must prove the two source-bound net changes independently from the whole-footprint transform. Reconstruct complete expected U15 by the exact net edits plus -0.5 mm translation, then compare full footprint structure, pads, mask/paste/custom geometry, graphics, text, UUIDs and all other fields. An ordinary pose-only receipt cannot authorize net edits.

No geometry algorithm change. Run actual bonded U15.1 and U15.2 cuts with complete externally routed source/target paths; check upstream NC10/NC9 island membership separately.

application_gate: This is an unselected metadata plan. Do not apply to canonical or frozen source CAD, generation inputs, native JSON, netlist or contract files. First select complete geometry including the separately declared whole U15 translation, original GND via/full .25 F lead and original R57 feed, plus complete RX/TX paths. Then apply the chosen paired changes only in a new isolated candidate, regenerate native geometry and a fresh full netlist from the candidate, bind candidate contracts to its exact PCB hash, and pass ERC/strict parity/native DRC, mechanical and every required physical bonded-pad cut. Neither this plan nor an incomplete local geometry probe is an adoption result.
